# AMS (Algorithms & Mathematics Society)

> AMS is an Indian organization that runs competitions in quantitative
> reasoning and systems engineering, and builds Access, a proctored assessment
> platform. Official site: https://www.amshq.in. AMS is not affiliated with the
> American Mathematical Society (ams.org) or other organizations sharing the
> acronym.

Key facts:

- AMS runs two contest series, Derive and Ascent. Its reported community reach is
  5,000+, with more than 30 institutions represented, as of July 2026.
  The Derive participation count is included in that wider community figure.
- Derive is the AMS quantitative reasoning contest, covering probability,
  markets, and mathematics. The 2026 edition had 2,500+ participants; 150
  advanced to Round 2, 50 qualified for the finals, and 33 competed in person
  at IIT Bombay in July 2026.
- Jane Street was the Apex Partner of Derive '26. Qube Research & Technologies
  (QRT) was the Convergence Partner of its finals. These relationships are
  specific to Derive '26.
- Ascent is the AMS C++ performance competition. Its format moves from an
  individual online qualifier to team optimization at partner campuses and
  an on-site codebase finale. Registration for the 2026 edition is free and
  open until 20 October 2026 at https://ascent.amshq.in/register. Round 1 is
  on 24 October at 2:00 pm IST and lasts two hours; Round 2 is on 6 December. The final is planned for
  20 December 2026 in Mumbai; that final date is tentative. The contest
  platform publishes the current schedule and entry requirements.
- Access is the AMS proctored assessment platform. It uses a desktop
  application with pre-session readiness checks and session audit records.
  Firms can discuss question sets, scoring, proctoring, and reporting with
  AMS. Any comparison with contest results requires an appropriate question
  set and reference group; contest participation alone is not a hiring
  recommendation.
- Eligibility differs by contest. The Derive '26 rules cover students in
  technical degree programs in India and recent alumni. Ascent publishes
  its own India and Asia-Pacific entry requirements on its contest site,
  including a limit of 100 seats for candidates outside India. Ascent
  registration is individual and requires a shareable Google Drive resume link.
- AMS is led by founder Tilak Jain (University of Mumbai). Kartik Agrawal
  (IIT Kanpur) is Head of Problem Design for AMS Derive 2026. Ayush Shukla
  (University of Mumbai) is Head of Community. Quasar Chunawala (CME Group)
  is Head of Problem Design for AMS Ascent 2026. Sahil is Head of Partnerships
  for AMS Derive 2026. These affiliations describe team members, not
  organizational sponsorships.
- Current sponsorship outreach prioritizes Ascent, with partnerships for future Derive editions
  also available to discuss via https://www.amshq.in/access. Access assessments
  are a separate conversation at https://www.amshq.in/access#assessments.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.amshq.in/): competitions, sponsorships, and the AMS record
- [Derive](https://www.amshq.in/derive): the quantitative reasoning contest and 2026 edition
- [Derive partners](https://www.amshq.in/derive#partners): the 2026 event partnerships
- [Ascent](https://www.amshq.in/ascent): the C++ performance competition
- [Ascent registration](https://ascent.amshq.in/register): enter Ascent '26
- [Partnerships](https://www.amshq.in/access): Ascent and Derive sponsorships, followed by hiring assessments
- [FAQ](https://www.amshq.in/faq): answers for participants and firms
- [Gallery](https://www.amshq.in/gallery): photographs from Derive '26 at IIT Bombay
- [Team](https://www.amshq.in/team): founder, team members, and contribution opportunities
- [Blog](https://www.amshq.in/blog): notes about AMS and its competitions

## Related properties

- [Derive 2026 rules](https://amsderive.in/rules): eligibility and rules for the 2026 edition
- [Ascent competition](https://ascent.amshq.in): current format, schedule, and registration
- [AMS Access](https://www.amsaccess.com/): the assessment application

## Official identity

- AMS previously used amsociety.in. Its current organization website is https://www.amshq.in/.
- [AMS on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/amshq/): official organization updates
- [AMS on GitHub](https://github.com/Algorithms-Mathematics-Society): organization repositories
- Individual team roles and LinkedIn profiles are listed at https://www.amshq.in/team.
